evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Equating an unrehearsed rollback with not having one frames rehearsal as the condition for security, while the aphoristic construction asserts mastery over the capability.
Setting a recurring cadence for rehearsals appeals to stability and security through regularity.
Naming an owner assigns personal accountability for the capability, appealing to mastery and craft ownership.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the value move here equating possession of a capability with demonstrated, rehearsed mastery of it?
